system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Vial (Consumable)

One ounce. There is no second ounce, and no known solvent short of Alkahest. It has the following Powers:

  • Sovereign Bond: Permanently bonds two objects. Only Alkahest will separate them.

Value: 10000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
